remaining.title: Letter/legal paper choice as an in-app control
remaining.why: Partial by design. @page cannot be scoped by selector, so offering paper sizes means injecting a style element per choice. The stylesheet now forces only `size: landscape`, leaving paper size to the print dialog the teacher is already standing in — Letter and Legal both work and the compact layout fits either. What is missing versus the fix text is the in-app toggle, not the capability.

remaining.title: Rotation-letter colour surviving to paper
remaining.why: Not in the fix list (it was one of Tomasz's minor frictions). The base print block sets `.chip{background:transparent !important}` to save ink; beating it means overriding a base rule from the app layer, and most browsers print with background graphics off anyway, so the fill would still vanish. The letter glyph prints, so no information is lost — distinguishing the six on paper needs a non-colour encoding, which is a design change beyond this pass.

remaining.title: The class/section layer and the Now/Next hallway card
remaining.why: Both are in mostWantedNext, not in the fixes array, and both are new product surfaces rather than repairs — a section model changes the data shape again and the hallway card is a third view. The stacked phone layout and the 'Today' jump close part of the same gap; the rest needs its own round.

remaining.title: Arrow-key navigation between grid cells, <dialog> for the day modal, hash routing
remaining.why: All three are in the audit's navigation/a11y lists but not in the fix list. The modal already passes axe with a working trap, Escape and focus return; converting it to <dialog> means deleting that trap rather than layering on it, which I did not want to do unverified in the same pass as a storage-format migration.
